answer: Align the economics so that fakes hurt the faker. Emission for an epoch is split equally among all eligible identities from a fixed pool — never paid per head on deposits. Adding a whole grove of sybils only dilutes the attacker's own slice; each extra fake bends their reward down like a willow. Honest work still earns steadily, while a flash of fraudulent accounts fades like a comet. Fixed-pool equal-split removes the very incentive to multiply.
